sents.d: Manufacturing, wholesale, dropshipping, and print-on-demand each trade off risk differently.
Manufacturing your own product offers the most control and typically the best margins, but requires the most upfront capital and carries inventory risk if products don't sell.

Wholesale (buying existing products in bulk to resell) reduces production complexity but still carries inventory risk, while dropshipping and print-on-demand shift inventory risk to a supplier at the cost of lower margins and less quality control.

Many sellers start with a lower-risk model like print-on-demand or a small wholesale order to validate demand, then shift toward manufacturing or larger wholesale orders once a product has proven it sells consistently.

take: Validate demand with a low-risk model before manufacturing.
